vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract has a pause mechanism that can be abused by the owner. When paused, only the owner can transfer tokens (see _transfer function check: require(!paused || sender == owner() || recipient == owner(), 'paused')). This allows the owner to pause the contract, preventing other users from selling tokens while the owner can still sell, potentially manipulating the market.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call the pause() function to pause all token transfers, then verify that paused == true.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call pause() on the DoctorShiba contract. 4. Verify that the paused state variable is now true.
